title: Legacy Monthly Average Exchange Rates (Valet export)
description: Monthly average noon rates, Canadian dollars per one foreign unit, 1999-01 to 2017-04; discontinued 2017-04-28. Series IEXM0101 (USD), EUROCAM01 (EUR), IEXM1201 (GBP), IEXM0701 (JPY), IEXM3001 (INR), IEXM2201 (CNY). Selected by series id rather than label because several series share a label - USD alone has six. Downloaded and processed in the CIMS repository, at data/raw_data/deflator_exchange/ and data/processed_data/deflator_exchange/, by CIMS.data_processing.source.deflator_exchange. The heat database holds only the two processed tables, copied verbatim into data/harmonized/ as reference-currency-deflator.csv and reference-currency-exchange.csv. Refresh by rerunning that script and recopying; do not edit the copies. Held here as reference-currency-exchange.csv (data/harmonized/records/reference): Context/Year/Value where Context is <TARGET>_per_<SOURCE>, 1999-2025 (all complete years in the raw files, 2026-10-02; 2000-2025 before), 56 directed pairs among the eight covered currencies. Annual averages of monthly rates over complete calendar years only. Cross rates derived through CAD. Combines the Bank of Canada legacy series with the Statistics Canada continuation (can-statcan_2026_001).
